text:
alex_m: Heads up — main is red, a bunch of tests failing with KMS decrypt errors and `vault: token lease not found` in the CI logs. Started at ~08:10 stack looks like secret sync missed a rotation. Can someone bisect the last 20 commits?

infra-bot: Detected anomaly: secret-sync job latency spike. Rolling window error rate 23% over last 10m. (job: secret-sync / namespace: infra)

priya: Thanks — linking logs: https://kibana.internal/redact/ci/1812345678 — can you paste the exact error lines?

alex_m: Sure — copy from failing job:
```
E 08:09:12 decrypt.go:87 "kms: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requestor does not have access to key projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/rotated-key"
E 08:09:13 vault.go:214 "token lease not found for path: secret/data/ci/sa-token"
```

jen_k: Which runner type? GH Actions or self-hosted? If self-hosted, maybe node lost GCP workload identity.

alex_m: Self-hosted k8s runners. Runner pods mount `ci-sa` secret via CSI driver from Vault. The sync job pushes the updated secret into k8s after rotation.

sam: I can start a quick bisect. Suggest narrowing to commits that touched infra/secret-sync and gha/runner-deploy. Do we have a failing commit range?

alex_m: Last successful main CI was at commit `f3a8b2e` (~20 commits back). First failure at `d4b7c9a` — probably around when we adjusted the sync backoff.

ops-sre: Quick check: run `kubectl get jobs -n infra secret-sync -o yaml` and look at `.status.completionTime` and `events`. Also check Vault audit for denied decrypts.

priya: Running the commands now, attaching snippet:
```
$ kubectl -n infra describe job secret-sync
Events:
  Warning  BackoffLimitExceeded  7m (x3 over 12m)  job-controller  Job has reached the specified backoff limit
```

priya: Vault audit shows repeated `permission_denied` calls from the sync service at 08:08–08:10. Might be a transient IAM propagation issue after key rotation.

ci-bot: CI Rerun requested by sam on job `integration-tests:main`. Rerun queued.

sam: Starting bisect: I'll run CI for commits `f3a8b2e..d4b7c9a` in halves to narrow. Ping me if you want to pair.

jen_k: Also please check the service account's IAM bindings to the KMS key: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ...` We rotated keys last night and maybe the binding didn't propagate to the new SA alias.

alex_m: Good call — I see the binding for `ci-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on the old key but not on the new one. That would explain PermissionDenied.

priya: Found the rollout job that touched bindings: commit `e8c1b9f` updated the rotation script to create a new key and add bindings asynchronously. Looks like it creates the key then schedules binding creation via a background job — race possible.

sam: Bisect result: commit `e8c1b9f` is the first bad. Reproduced decrypt error on that commit.

alex_m: Nice. Can we hotfix by reapplying binding to new key? If yes, do that and then re-run CI.

ops-sre: I can apply immediate IAM binding: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding rotated-key --member=serviceAccount:ci-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` — applying now.

infra-bot: Action taken: IAM binding added to `rotated-key` by ops-sre.

ci-bot: Rerun queued (requested by alex_m).

priya: Re-run logs show decrypt succeeded and `vault: token lease renewed` now. Integration tests progressing.

jen_k: We should also fix the rotation script to wait for binding confirmation or retry with exponential backoff. I'll open a PR with a small change to poll the key IAM state and fail-safe revert.

sam: Tests green on rerun ✅ — looks like that fixed it.

alex_m: Great work — thanks ops-sre and priya for quick triage. For postmortem: I'll create a short note in #incidents and link PR from jen_k that hardens rotation.

priya: Adding a short alert in PagerDuty to catch future binding propagation failures.

ops-sre: Filed follow-up ticket: infra/secret-sync-#452 — ensure rotation atomicity and add metrics for bind latency.

alex_m: Closing the thread — if anything else pops up, re-open here. :thumbsup:
